# Adobe XDP sample layouts (test fixtures)

The `.xdp` files are SAP sample form templates, used unchanged to test the XFA renderer:

- `zf_cine_ticket.xdp`, `zform_fdp_scratch.xdp` — from [SAP-samples/forms-service-by-adobe-samples](https://github.com/SAP-samples/forms-service-by-adobe-samples) (`forms/`)
- `zpra_mf_musicfestival.xdp` — from [SAP-samples/abap-partner-reference-application](https://github.com/SAP-samples/abap-partner-reference-application) (`Tutorials/assets/`)
